blocks.text: Filipino mythology film “Forgotten Island” opened to a nearly P98 million at the Philippine box office, marking the biggest opening weekend for a DreamWorks Animation film in the country. The animated film earned P97,236,533 during its opening weekend, according to its distributor Universal Pictures. The figure also makes “Forgotten Island” the biggest non-franchise animated film opening in the Philippines. The film, which draws from Filipino mythology and culture, follows best friends Raissa and Jo as they find themselves transported to the mysterious island of Nakali after discovering a magical portal on the night of their high school graduation.
